strategy: Use Flay to apply Vulnerable and generate Fury, then rely on Rend's high base damage for primary offense, supplementing with Iron Maelstrom for screen-clearing burst potential. Focus on generic damage modifiers, Fury generation, Armor, and Resistances across progression to level 70.

paragon.note: This is the Endgame (Physical) variant order. The Self-Cast (Fire) variant uses Challenger, Undaunted, Disembowel, Might, Executioner; Push (Overpower) variants use Dominate, Challenger, Crusher/Exploit, Ambidextrous/Executioner, Disembowel. Maxroll shows this build's Paragon board pathing through an interactive planner (D4Planner) rather than as plain text, so the exact board order can't be faithfully scraped - check source_url for the visual layout.
